🔴🔴 v 🟡🟡

The Bach travel to League newcomers Brereton Social today for a 3pm kick off as we look to extend our unbeaten run to 4 games.  With The Bach currently in 2 place on 15 points an away win will further strengthen our position at the top end of the table, lets go Bach!

🔴🔴 v 🟡🟡

Brereton Social v Sandbach United

The sun is shining here in Rugeley this afternoon let’s hope it’s shining on The Bach at 4.50pm  ☀️ https://t.co/FiT31j4HgB
Sandbach line up for today’s game. https://t.co/1tSG555dsD
As we approach the kick off today against @breretonsocialf in the @nwcfl we applaud @declan_swan on his 200th game in charge of @SandbachUtd https://t.co/pH6B4riRK1
